new_findings.text: The offline SharedObject schema is bigger than the packet's persistence claim states. QueryManagerBase.as's offlineMode branch does not end at :2925 — it continues to :2930 and writes five more fields: activeQuestList (:2926), completedQuestList (:2927), playerlocation (:2928), taunt (:2929) and friends (:2930). Counting the fourteen at :2912-2925 plus these, the branch serialises NINETEEN fields to SharedObject.getLocal(cookieName + '_' + charname). A single-player persistence schema transcribed from :2912-2925 alone would silently drop the entire quest state, the player's world location, the taunt and the friend list — i.e. a reload would put the character back with no active or completed quests and no saved position.
new_findings.lane_impact: L10 persistence: the transcribe-don't-invent conclusion stands, but the range to transcribe is :2912-2930 (nineteen fields), not :2912-2925 (fourteen). Quest state and world location are in the shipped save format.
